summary: Two questions for the operator: P3/P5 put tests into deploy repos' gates, which conflicts with 'deploy repos run no tests' (D61) and pre-empts slice 027's pending promtool ruling; and the standing out-of-sync alert leaves out apps Argo CD does not auto-sync, which Ruling D1 does not. Two advisory notes (P4 tag numbering vs the runbook; no ArgoCDDeploy-before-PrometheusDeploy push order); citations otherwise verified.
